## Checklist

- [ ] `go test -race ./...` passes
- [ ] `gofmt -l .` is empty

- [ ] `golangci-lint run` passes

- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated (for user-facing changes)
- [ ] No API tokens or secrets committed
- [ ] Public API changes are backward compatible (v1)
